principle: A witness certifies only the proposition inside its declared claim boundary.

composition.rule: Independent witnesses accumulate evidence; no witness inherits the authority of another.
composition.conflict_policy: A failed mandatory witness dominates passing sibling witnesses for the grade that requires it. Conflicting non-mandatory witnesses remain visible and require adjudication.

witnesses.name: Deterministic unit tests
witnesses.claim: Enumerated local implementation invariants hold for the tested cases.
witnesses.authority: pytest assertions in the pinned repository commit

witnesses.name: Static type witness
witnesses.claim: The checked Python surface satisfies the configured mypy type constraints.

witnesses.name: Browser contract witness
witnesses.claim: The generated web artifact satisfies the explicitly tested browser/runtime contract in Chromium.
witnesses.authority: Playwright browser smoke against generated _site artifact

witnesses.name: Automated WCAG witness
witnesses.claim: axe-core reports zero automatically detectable WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 Level A/AA violations on every primary product page.

witnesses.name: Reproducibility witness
witnesses.claim: Repeated builds from identical declared inputs produce byte-identical site output.

witnesses.name: Static site resource budget witness
witnesses.claim: The generated static site remains within the versioned first-party and single-vendor byte budgets.
witnesses.authority: deterministic byte counts over the generated _site artifact

witnesses.name: Formal proof replay witness
witnesses.claim: The pinned Four Color formal artifact is accepted by the pinned Rocq checker/toolchain.
witnesses.authority: Rocq kernel/checker on pinned upstream artifact

witnesses.name: Differential execution witness
witnesses.claim: For the certified input domain, source execution and executable MeTTa lowering agree on observable results.
witnesses.authority: independent execution of source and MeTTa artifacts

witnesses.name: Metamorphic semantic witness
witnesses.claim: Semantics-preserving source perturbations preserve recovered labels while evidence relocates appropriately.

witnesses.name: Mutation sensitivity witness
witnesses.claim: The test suite detects a defined proportion of meaningfully mutated implementations.
witnesses.authority: pinned mutation operator set and mutation score

witnesses.name: Fuzz and parser resilience witness
witnesses.claim: Adapters and parsers satisfy declared crash/resource/error-handling properties over the fuzz campaign.
witnesses.authority: seeded fuzz corpus and campaign artifacts

witnesses.name: Supply-chain provenance witness
witnesses.claim: Release artifacts carry declared dependency inventory, licenses, hashes, and build provenance.

witnesses.name: Performance and resource witness
witnesses.claim: Certified workloads remain within declared time, memory, output-size, and browser-asset budgets.
